title: Build a program, a package, or the compiler itself
summary: Requirements: ooRexx 5.3 with include/oorexxapi.h (OO_ROOT names its prefix, default /usr/local), a C++17 compiler (g++ 13 by default, CXX= chooses clang++), and the Boost headers (boost/multiprecision/cpp_int.hpp; Debian/Ubuntu package libboost-dev). Whole program: native/compile_program.sh prog.rex outdir, then run LD_LIBRARY_PATH=outdir rexx outdir/prog.rex. One class package: native/build.sh pkg.cls outdir name. The compiler compiled by itself: native/build_self.sh outdir builds outdir/librx2cppc.so and fails unless the fixed point holds; RX2CPP_COMPILER_LIB=outdir makes build.sh generate with it.
procedure: Whole program into one library and a launcher: native/compile_program.sh prog.rex outdir
One library per required file (packages kept separate, as interpreted): RX2CPP_SEPARATE_PACKAGES=1 native/compile_program.sh prog.rex outdir
Keep a required package interpreted (BSF.CLS, python.cls): RX2CPP_KEEP_INTERPRETED="BSF.CLS"
Keep the generated C++ for inspection: RX2CPP_KEEP_STAGE=1
Per-phase generator timings on stderr: RX2CPP_PROGRESS=1
Tests need the interpreter's library and the source root on the path: export REXX_LIB=$OO_ROOT/lib REXX_PATH=$PWD (from the oorexx2cpp folder)
Build the compiler with itself and check the fixed point: native/build_self.sh outdir
invariants: A ::REQUIRES that is not compiled (not found, a .rex package, or kept) is loaded by the interpreter at run time; the build prints a warning.
By default the program and its required files share one package (non-PUBLIC routines and classes visible to all); RX2CPP_SEPARATE_PACKAGES=1 gives the interpreter's visibility.
Build large libraries alone on small machines: cc1plus for the Rexx Parser benchmark was killed by the OOM killer when other builds ran beside it.
The compiled compiler library must be rebuilt after any change to rules/ or the compiler packages.
